capabilities: Add tooltip text to a selected word via right-click
Show tooltips on hover over marked words in Reading View
Customize how marked words are highlighted
Generate a vocabulary list note linking words back to their sources
extras: Tooltips only appear in Reading View, not while editing; the generated vocabulary list updates automatically whenever a note is saved.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach a hover definition or translation to an individual word inside a note.
summary: Hover-tooltip plugin that attaches definitions to selected words via right-click, stores them as {word::tooltip} syntax, and builds a vault-wide vocabulary list.
